title: SuperSoil - Soil DNA Extraction
author: Jie Hao Ou
materials: Add following materials to 1.8 ml centrifuge tube 250 mg soil 1.5 g Bead 800 µl SD1

steps.title: Vortex Sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the sample horizontally at max speed for 10 minutes, ensuring the cap is tightly sealed.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (expected volume 500–600 µl) to a clean 1.5 ml or 2 ml tube.

steps.title: Add SD2 Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of SD2 to the tube; a white precipitate should form.

steps.title: Vortex Mixture
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture at max speed for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 minute (note: supernatant may appear yellow).

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (expected volume 500–600 µl) to a clean 1.5 ml or 2 ml tube.

steps.title: Add SD3 Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl of SD3 to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex Mixture
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture at max speed for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Load Lysate to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a spin column in two parts: first transfer 650 µl, then transfer the remaining lysate.

steps.title: Add SEA Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of SEA to the spin column.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Discard Flow-through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 minute to remove remaining ethanol (S5) and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Add S5 Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of S5 to the spin column.

steps.title: Add S6 Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 50–100 µl of S6 to the spin column.
